title: Temporal coverage expectation and delivery gate: component identity bound to every coverage evidence record
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE - all 221 MD-B15 mandatory predicates are proven by executed guards. The stage opened at a denominator of 221 rather than the 89 the Stage Register carried, because 108 predicates arrived filed as reference context or as mixed-run siblings while carrying real coverage obligations: the forbidden expectation-exclusion list, the numerator exclusions, the three gate-state definitions, the reason-code mapping, the required audit-visible fields and the forbidden fallback targets.

authority_basis.note: MD-B14 closure is a stage precondition only. No MD-B14 predicate proof is inherited: every one of the 221 predicates bound here was proven by a guard executed during this attempt.

required_semantics_proven: The coverage denominator is EXPECTED + UNKNOWN, and only verified point-in-time NOT_EXPECTED evidence may reduce it.
Dormancy, zero volume, illiquidity, provider absence, current activity and downstream preference never reduce the denominator.
UNKNOWN remains in the fail-safe denominator and is never silently treated as NOT_EXPECTED.

The numerator counts traceably delivered requested-date observations, and excludes request success without an observation, stale rows, duplicates, fabricated rows and observations outside the temporal universe.
Delivery, canonical validity, quality, liquidity, event risk and eligibility are separate counts and states; coverage absorbs none of them.
The locked 0.98 threshold resolves identically through the current config key and the legacy alias.
An empty denominator yields a null ratio and NOT_EVALUABLE rather than a coerced 0 or 1.
Legacy BLOCKED is normalized to NOT_EVALUABLE and survives only as an explicit raw marker.
FAIL and NOT_EVALUABLE finalize as NOT_READABLE, and fallback preserves the prior readable publication without making the failed candidate readable.
No candidate with coverage FAIL or NOT_EVALUABLE becomes current.
Every coverage evidence record binds the universe resolver version and the calendar and trading-status revision identities, not only the contract version.
A coverage record never reports a revision identity it could not resolve.
Stale rows never count for the requested date and keep the publication NOT_READABLE.
Retry, rate limit and timeout are source-acquisition behaviour and never a coverage bypass.
The denominator exclusion path is exercised by a governed test rather than trusted for being rare.
Coverage PASS is never cited as evidence of data correctness, calendar correctness or session completeness.

coverage.binding: All 221 MD-B15 mandatory predicates are atomically bound to E-MD-B15-A001-001 by MarketDataCoverageGateProofBinder. The binder refuses a partial binding.

defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.defect: Coverage evidence bound only its own contract version.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.detail: EOD_COVERAGE_GATE_CONTRACT_LOCKED.md requires every coverage evidence record to bind the identity/universe resolver version and the calendar and trading-status revision identities used to resolve expectation, and generalises it: evidence binds the version of every component its correctness depends on. The evaluator published coverage_contract_version, coverage_calibration_version and universe_hash_schema_version - three names for what the contract said, and nothing about the components that produced the numbers. A stored result was indistinguishable from one produced by a resolver since found defective, which is the exact condition the contract describes.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.remediation: CoverageGateEvaluator publishes UNIVERSE_RESOLVER_VERSION, and takes MarketCalendarRepository so it can bind the calendar revision id and uid actually resolved for the date. EventRiskSourceRepository gained expectationStatusRevisionIdsAsOf(), exposing the trading-status revisions it already resolved per listing and then discarded. The identity is emitted on the NOT_EVALUABLE path too, and is left null rather than defaulted when a revision cannot be resolved.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.guard: CoverageEvidenceComponentIdentityTest, four tests, all four mutation-probed.

defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.defect: A stage-entry classification error in this attempt's own first pass.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.detail: MD-S024-R0065 was classified as a routing statement and filed reference. It is the companion obligation to MD-S024-R0064, which the matrix already carried as REQUIRED, and it states an independent burden of proof. The classification consistency gate reported it as a surviving mixed-run member.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.remediation: The matrix was restored to its pre-normalization state and the pass re-run once with the corrected classification, rather than patching the row in place. The denominator moved from 220 to 221.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.guard: MarketDataClassificationConsistencyGate, which caught it before any binding.

residue.scope: Coverage evaluation, expectation resolution, finalize decision, publishability and pointer enforcement, evidence export and replay comparison.
notes: Coverage records produced before this attempt bind no resolver or revision identity. They are not back-stamped: writing an identity onto a record whose producer was never recorded would assert a fact that was never true. EOD_COVERAGE_GATE_CONTRACT_LOCKED.md already governs them - such evidence is either re-derived under current components or explicitly qualified wherever it is cited.
F-MD-B01-A014-001 remains open and is owned by MD-B19. F-MD-B14-A001-001 remains open and is a reason-code vocabulary matter outside this stage. Neither blocks MD-B15.

no_inheritance_statement: No predicate is claimed on historical material. Every one of the 221 was proven by a guard executed in this attempt, and every guard the attempt relies on was shown to fail under an injected defect.
